'''Moonglow''' is a horse, formerly belonging to the [[Band of the Red Hand]]. Moonglow is now owned by [[Joline Maza]].

==Activities==
When the [[Aes Sedai]] leave his camp, [[Mat Cauthon]] grudgingly parts with a number of horses, including Moonglow and [[Firewisp]].{{ref/book|13|17}}
